pages.title: Collagen Seam
pages.text: A band of collagen fibres through the matrix. Found in Inner Space, in its matrix. Mined, it gives Matrix Fibre; matrix and fibre lay more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the rock (mine it for its drop).$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.
